question: After the inclusion of the Maratha Military Landscapes of India in 2025, how many total UNESCO World Heritage Sites are there in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**44**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of **2023**, India has **41 UNESCO World Heritage Sites**, which include cultural, natural, and mixed heritage sites recognized for their universal significance.
 
• The inclusion of the **Maratha Military Landscapes of India** in **2025** will add one more site to the list, making the total number of UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India **44**.
